newsitem.title: DUBAI: Most United Arab Emirates shares end the week flat.
newsitem.headline: Most United Arab Emirates shares end the week flat.

text.p: Most shares on the United Arab Emirates' unofficial stock market were unchanged in the week to Thursday, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) index was mainly unchanged, edging up to 2,581.03 from 2,579.35 points. Of the 27 traded firms, shares of only three rose, nine dropped and the rest were flat.
Al-Khazna Insurance extended recent losses, falling five dirhams to 260 after a 10 dirham fall the previous week. The new Emaar Properties was down one dirham at 16.
Among gainers were Abu Dhabi National Insurance which gathered 15 dirhams to close at 1,115 and NBAD which gained five dirhams to 550.
For the second week running, Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank was unchanged at 350. Union National Bank was down five dirhams at 355.
